text:
sara: Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands infra segment (GPU supply, regions, autoscale). I'll capture clarifications and owners.

devin: For planning: will APAC capacity be H100-only or a mixed fleet? our feature teams need perf deltas.

lia: Mixed fleet. Primary low-latency lanes get H100s; cost-optimized batch lanes get L40s. Procurement ETA varies by vendor, see linked perf matrix.

matt: For EU dedicated pools  when can sales take reservations? need dates to schedule customer comms.

renee: tentative reservation open date is June 15 (beta). Sales to confirm by EOD Thu. We'll cap beta slots.

devin: autoscaler  what's the safe default for cross-region bursting? curious about cache behavior and billing controls.

lia: default: regionalBurst=false. If teams enable regionalBurst, recommend maxBurstPct=20 and stickyRouting=true for low-latency endpoints. Cache behavior: if same model+runtime exists in target region, prefix KV preserved; otherwise cold start applies.

infra-bot: Uploads: https://redwood.s3/all-hands/2026-03/infra-summary.pdf ; perf: https://redwood.s3/perf/region-curves.csv

sara: action items: 1) Lia -> post canary checklist + rollback steps (due Mon) 2) Renee/Sales -> confirm EU reservation date (due Thu) 3) DevEx -> draft product playbook for config presets (due Wed).

matt: i'll block time with Sales and Contracts now.

devin: thanks. can we also get a short note for teams about spot availability in APAC?

lia: spot planned as opt-in; capacity depends on vendor. We'll publish spot pool guidance in the runbook.

sara: closing this thread. if anyone has urgent follow-ups ping me or drop in #eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:
